items.title: UC Davis Health's IFM Fund Increases Its Commitment to Delix Therapeutics as At-Home Depression Trial Advances
items.summary: UC Davis Health’s IFM Fund doubled down on Delix Therapeutics in its Series C to advance Zalsupindole (DLX‑001), an oral, non‑hallucinogenic neuroplastogen entering an FDA‑cleared Phase IIb at‑home trial for rapid, durable treatment of major depressive disorder.

items.title: From Breakthrough Research to Investment-ready Ventures: Aggie Venture Accelerator’s Inaugural Cohort Reaches Key Milestone
items.summary: Aggie Venture Accelerator (AVA) celebrated its inaugural cohort as the participating startups—Pharm to Food, ThriveSpan Labs and SinewUS—completed the four-month program, advancing UC Davis life-science spinouts toward investor-ready ventures.

items.title: UC Davis Health Strengthens Taiwan Partnerships to Advance Biomedical Innovation
items.summary: UC Davis Health expanded Taiwan partnerships to accelerate biomedical innovation, linking Aggie Square, universities and industry to drive research, commercialization and clinical translation in cell & gene therapy, cancer, medical devices, digital health and AI.

items.title: UC Davis, Partners Launch Scale-Up Program to Help South Korean Startups Enter U.S. Market
items.summary: UC Davis, FLANN and partners launched the nine-month Scale-Up Program to help South Korean life-sciences startups enter the U.S. market via Aggie Square, offering clinical collaboration, U.S. market validation, commercialization support, investor access and strategic partnerships.

items.title: From Lab to Livestock: How Customer Discovery Helped 2C Bioscience Find Its Focus
items.summary: Through the NSF I-Corps customer discovery program, 2C Bioscience found its beachhead market and a path towards faster commercialization—demonstrating how industry engagement can help turn lab innovations into viable business opportunities.

items.title: UC Davis–born amplifye Targets a New Frontier in Protein Efficiency Amid GLP-1 Era
items.summary: Born out of cross-disciplinary research at University of California, Davis, startup amplifye is developing enzyme-based technology designed to improve protein absorption and muscle health as growing use of GLP-1 therapies reshapes nutrition and metabolic health needs.

items.title: Aggie Square Partners Release First Community Benefits Progress Report Highlighting Early Impact
items.summary: The first Aggie Square Community Benefits Partnership Agreement (CBPA) Annual Progress Report has been released by UC Davis, the City of Sacramento and Wexford Science & Technology, documenting significant progress towards meeting many of the goals outlined in the CBPA.

items.title: UC Davis Health Ventures Appoints Troels Adrian to Strengthen Industry Partnerships and Advance the UC Davis Health Clinical Test Bed
items.summary: UC Davis Health Ventures, part of the Innovation and Economic Development Office at UC Davis, today announced the appointment of Troels Adrian as Director of Industry Engagement.

items.title: Food & Health Angels Network Launches to Accelerate Science-Driven Food and Health Innovation
items.summary: Introducing the Food & Health Angels Network, a groundbreaking initiative launched to accelerate science-driven innovations in food and health, addressing the pressing issue of metabolic disease.

items.title: UC Davis Highlights Translational Breakthroughs and Startups at the 8th Annual Biotech Innovation Gallery
items.summary: UC Davis showcased groundbreaking translational research and innovative biotech startups at the 8th Annual Biotech Innovation Gallery in San Francisco. Hosted by the UC Davis Innovation and Economic Development Office, the event brought in over 330 attendees to connect with and explore potential partnerships with researchers and startup founders, aligning with the J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference

items.title: UC Davis Announces Winners of Autumn 2025 Science Translation and Innovative Research Grant Program
items.summary: The University of California, Davis, has awarded $100,000 through the autumn 2025 cohort of the Science Translation and Innovative Research (STAIR) Grant Program to help scientists advance innovative research with strong commercial potential.

items.title: Venture Catalyst Fuels Record Year for UC Davis Innovation Startups
items.summary: At Venture Catalyst, part of the UC Davis Innovation and Economic Development Office, we're proud to support the translation of UC Davis research and technology into real-world applications by fostering the development of new ventures.
